hints.title: Monotonic Sum Function
hints.text: As the clipping threshold value increases, the clamped sum of the array increases monotonically.

hints.title: Binary Search the Threshold
hints.text: Binary search over candidate threshold values between 0 and max(arr). Find the threshold where sum is closest to target.

hints.title: Break Ties Towards Minimum
hints.text: Compare the sum at candidate v and v + 1. If both achieve the minimal absolute difference, return the smaller value.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing every value from 0 to max(arr) linearly takes O(N * max(arr)).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Binary search exploits monotonicity of the mutated sum in logarithmic steps.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate applies binary search on answer and carefully resolves tie-breaking.
complexity.notes: Can also sort arr and use prefix sums for O(N log N) total.
